hypotheses.claim: Qwen3.5-4B is currently a high-value primary candidate for Frank because one 4B model can cover text, vision, multilingual and agent/tool behavior.
hypotheses.falsifier: Frank-specific target-host eval loses materially on identity/state grounding, safety, latency/memory or runtime stability versus another feasible 4B candidate.

hypotheses.claim: Qwen3-4B should remain a stable text-only 4B control/fallback until Qwen3.5 runtime/quantization stability is target-proven.
hypotheses.falsifier: Qwen3.5-4B equals or beats it on Frank's target metrics with acceptable memory/package complexity and reproducible local runtime.

hypotheses.claim: F6 should standardize an engine-neutral Frank inference adapter before choosing llama.cpp, vLLM, SGLang or another backend.
hypotheses.falsifier: A single engine is target-proven across required hardware, packaging, model/quantization and update/recovery constraints such that abstraction measurably adds more risk than portability.

hypotheses.claim: Model-card benchmark quality is insufficient for production selection; Frank-specific evals must precede fine-tune and F7 packaging lock-in.
hypotheses.falsifier: none accepted without target execution evidence because F6 pass condition itself requires Frank-specific identity/state/GRT/routing/safety regressions.

feedback.frank: Do not bind Frank identity to a provider/runtime; treat the local 4B model as one replaceable organ behind stable state/tool contracts.
feedback.claycode: Define model I/O around deterministic state capsules, structured proposal/route outputs and explicit authority; engine-specific chat templates must not become Clay semantics.
feedback.gwt: Measure whether the local model can consume selected/broadcast state and produce receiptable re-entry rather than merely imitate workspace vocabulary.
feedback.hyperposition: Evaluate preservation of multiple alternatives without premature collapse and exact lineage back to the injected state snapshot.
feedback.unifieddb: Model receives bounded state projections; it must not become a second persistence authority.
feedback.claygraph: Model graph reasoning must be grounded in derived graph epochs, not latent invented topology.
feedback.harness: Fine-tuned model may propose self-Harness changes but cannot acquire promotion authority through fine-tuning.
feedback.clay: Delay production model/engine lock-in until F5 target-body evidence makes memory/backend constraints empirical.

negative_results: No production model selected in this run.
No production inference engine selected in this run.

No F6 gate promotion without target-machine eval.
